pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vosāsantiyo ṭhitā honti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.4: idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo vosāsantiyo na nivāressantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo vosāsantiyo na nivārethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā . . . na nivāressatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.15.1: bhikkhū pan' eva kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti. tatra ce sā bhikkhunī vosāsamānarūpā ṭhitā hoti idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethā 'ti, tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā apasakka tāva bhagini yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantīti. ekassa ce pi bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ apasakka . . . bhuñjantīti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.16: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjimhā asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.1: bhikkhū pan' eva kulesu nimantitā bhuñjantīti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.2: kulaṃ nāma cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.4: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.8: yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamānupajjhāyatā yathāsamānācariyatā, idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethā 'ti, esā vosāsantī nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.13: tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā apasakka . . . bhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.14: ekassa ce pi bhikkhuno anapasādite khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññī vosāsantiyā na nivāreti, āpatti pāṭidesaniyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.4: ekatoupasampannāya vosāsantiyā na nivāreti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
